method: Two independent sources, both read-only off xzgpu: (1) metrics.jsonl's reader_reopen_on_enoent_total counter (10895 samples across all 8 readers), max final value taken per reader; (2) each reader-<idx>-progress.json's own reopen_on_enoent_total field (written once, at the reader's final flush, final=true). Both agree exactly: 0 for every reader. reopens (plain reopen count, not on-ENOENT) is 272 for all 8 readers -- the designed --reader-reopen-every-s 300 cadence over the ~86334s run (86334/300 ~ 288, close to 272 after accounting for the reopen interval starting partway through the first minute and the run's final partial interval), none of which hit ENOENT.
